class.name: CircBuffer
class.description: Description of a shared ring buffer. Used by Muon Calibration SW (siom pkg) and HLT

attribute.name: CircName
attribute.description: Name of the buffer

attribute.name: CircSize
attribute.description: Buffer size in bytes. If 0, connect in slave mode.

class.name: CircDataOut
class.description: Output class for the IO Manager to send events to a circular buffer. Can work in both master and slave mode, either pretending to write out all the events or to skip them when the output buffer is full.

attribute.name: OutputCircName
attribute.description: This is the name of the output circular buffer.

attribute.name: SamplingGap
attribute.description: Define the minimum gap between two sampled events. As a consequence, a maximum sampling ratio is defined. If the ThrowIfFull parameter is true, sampled event can be skipped if the buffer is full, else all the events are written as soon as there is room in the buffer. The default value (1) means that all the events are sent to the output, 0 means that no event is sent.

attribute.name: OutputDelay
attribute.description: Delay the output

attribute.name: BufferSize
attribute.description: The size of the circular buffer to be used. BufferSize=0 means that the access will be in slave mode (i.e., the buffer is created by someone else).

attribute.name: ThrowIfFull
attribute.description: If the ThrowIfFull parameter is true, sampled event can be skipped if the buffer is full, else all the events are written as soon as there is room in the buffer, thus generating backpressure.

class.name: DFParameters

attribute.name: BasePortEFD_SFI

attribute.name: BasePortEFD_SFO
attribute.description: Base port for the calculation of Ports for EFD for the SFOs.

attribute.name: MulticastAddress
attribute.description: Define the multicast address for message passing. Format is IPaddress/IPNetwork, using the IPV4 dot notation.

attribute.name: DefaultDataNetworks
attribute.description: A list of network addresses/mask to specify the default networks to be used for message passing. The addresses and masks should be given in the IPV4 dot notation.

relationship.name: UsesDataFiles
relationship.description: Link to the files containing raw detector data.

attribute.name: QueueSize
attribute.description: Determines the queue size between datainput and trigger.

attribute.name: QueueUnblockOffset
attribute.description: Number of elements in the queue that must be popped before the queue is unblocked i.e. enabled for push. To avoid excessive thread switching.

attribute.name: RequestType
attribute.description: Type of request instantiated when data arrives. Known types are: AllRequestWithRelease and EBRequestWithRelease.

attribute.name: SingleFragmentMode
attribute.description: This flag, if set causes the DataDrivenTrigger and Sequential Input mechanism to operate in a mode where a new data request is generated for each channel individually. That is, the system will not wait for a fragment with the same l1id on all channels before generating a request.

attribute.name: FileName
attribute.description: Name of file containing raw data to be uploaded in the ROS for HLT studies.

attribute.name: ClearLossThreshold
attribute.description: Number of DFM_Clear_Messages allowed to be lost before garbage collection is triggered. A value of 0 means never trigger garbage collection.

relationship.name: MessageLossEmulations
relationship.description: Specifies the percentage of lost messages arriving to the ROS (for clear, ROI and EB messages).

class.name: EFIOConfiguration

attribute.description: Maximum number of EFIO handlers (threads). Unlimited is 0 (zero).

attribute.name: EFD_SFO_RcvTimeout_ms

attribute.name: SendTimeout_ms
attribute.description: Timeout for sending (ms)

attribute.name: NagleEnable
attribute.description: Switches the Nagle Algorithm for the EFIO TCP data transfer

attribute.name: TCPSendBufferSize

attribute.name: TCPRecvBufferSize
attribute.description: Sets the TCP receive Buffer size. 0 means default.

attribute.name: TCPKeepIdle
attribute.description: Timeout in sec before sending the first TCPKEEPALIVE probe; if zero TCPKEEPALIVE is disabled (default)

attribute.name: TCPKeepIntvl

attribute.name: TCPKeepCnt

attribute.name: QoSPriority
attribute.description: DSCP priority. 0 means default.

attribute.name: ClientCommunicationErrorRetryIntervalLong_s
attribute.description: Waiting time between reconnections after a number of communication errors greater than ClientCommunicationErrorThreshold (s)

attribute.name: ClientCommunicationErrorRetryIntervalShort_s
attribute.description: Waiting time between reconnections after a number of communication errors less than ClientCommunicationErrorThreshold (s)

attribute.name: ClientCommunicationErrorThreshold
attribute.description: Maximum number of communication errors before switching to slow reconnection mode

attribute.name: ClientConnectionErrorRetryIntervalLong_s
attribute.description: Waiting time between reconnections after a number of connection errors greater than ClientConnectionErrorThreshold (s)

attribute.name: ClientConnectionErrorRetryIntervalShort_s
attribute.description: Waiting time between reconnections after a number of connection errors less than ClientConnectionErrorThreshold (s)

attribute.name: ClientConnectionErrorThreshold
attribute.description: Maximum number of connection errors before switching to slow reconnection mode

attribute.name: ClientConnectionTimeout_ms
attribute.description: Timeout for connection to the server (ms)

attribute.name: MaxEventSize
attribute.description: Maximum Event Size (B) (used for detecting communication errors) (default is 64 MiB)
